data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

Silver Rock's most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in CABO, OPTU, and CYH.

On October 2, 2026, CABO entered into a material definitive agreement under 8-K Item 1.01 (filed October 2, 2026) (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1632127/000095015726001058/form8-k.htm).

I can send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
